properties.name: triggers
properties.title: Triggers
properties.description: One row for each push button wired between a GPIO pin (BCM number) and ground, and what pressing it does: play, stop, toggle (stop while playing, else play) or next (the next page of the playlist). Each of those can be on one button only. Not a pin the panel uses (the app says which, if you choose one). Changes apply within a few seconds.

properties.name: pin
properties.title: GPIO Pin
properties.description: The GPIO number (BCM) the button is wired to.
